payload.goal: Starting from the verified W1 Warehouse codebase, implement WC1 as a complete vertical slice. Add atomic orders and reservations with valid order status transitions. Add a versioned HTTP API under /api/v1 for state, order creation, reservation, status transitions and deterministic simulation actions play, pause, step and reset. Add a monotonic Server-Sent Events stream at /api/v1/events. Add a static accessible browser UI served by the start script: an SVG warehouse tower with heatmap plus exact textual bin detail including empty bins, simulation controls operable by keyboard, explicit loading/empty/error/connected states, reduced-motion support and status communication not based on color alone. Add src/probe/wc1.ts and a package script study:wc1-probe that emits one deterministic JSON object with schemaVersion 1, increment WC1, scenario thesis-seed-2026, bins, occupiedBins, emptyBins and simulationControls. Preserve all W1 behavior. Keep the implementation dependency-free and add public behavior tests for atomicity, invalid transitions, API/SSE, simulation, tower accessibility and probe determinism. Do not implement WC2 or WC3 in this cell.

root.title: WC1 Warehouse vertical slice
root.objective: Implement WC1 from the verified W1 warehouse codebase while preserving W1 behavior, adding order/reservation domain logic, versioned API/SSE, static accessible UI, deterministic simulation controls, and the WC1 probe.
expectedOutcomes: WC1 domain behavior is modeled and tested without weakening existing inventory, layout, scenario, or W1 probe behavior.
The dependency-free start script serves both the /api/v1 API and the static accessible tower UI.
The WC1 probe emits the required deterministic schemaVersion 1 JSON object.
Public behavior tests cover atomicity, invalid transitions, API/SSE, simulation, tower accessibility, and probe determinism.
No WC2 or WC3 scope is introduced.

complexitySignals.rationale: The slice spans existing domain, scenarios, probe conventions, package scripts, new HTTP/SSE behavior, static UI assets, and new public behavior tests.

cut.rationale: The children separate independently verifiable concerns: domain invariants, deterministic simulation state, transport/static serving, browser UI behavior, and probe output. The cuts are not by layer alone: each leaf owns its tests and the local contracts needed to verify the behavior it introduces.

children.title: Atomic orders and reservations
children.objective: Add cohesive domain support for atomic order creation, reservation allocation, and valid order status transitions with regression tests that preserve existing W1 inventory and layout behavior.
expectedOutcomes: A dependency-free order and reservation domain module represents valid order states and rejects invalid transitions.
Reservation creation is atomic: either all requested reservation effects are applied or none are applied.
Domain tests cover successful reservation, failed atomic reservation, valid transitions, invalid transitions, and unchanged W1 inventory/layout expectations.

complexitySignals.rationale: The work introduces a new domain contract and tests it against existing inventory, layout, and scenario concepts.

children.title: Deterministic simulation core
children.objective: Add a dependency-free deterministic simulation state model and play, pause, step, reset actions that operate over the W1/WC1 warehouse state and expose exact state snapshots for API and probe consumers.
expectedOutcomes: Simulation actions play, pause, step, and reset are deterministic and operate through an explicit simulation state contract.
State snapshots expose bins, occupied bins, empty bins, orders, reservations, and simulation control availability as needed by API and probe consumers.
Simulation tests verify reset determinism, step progression, pause/play semantics, and preservation of W1 thesis seed warehouse facts.

complexitySignals.rationale: The simulator is a shared contract consumed by the API and probe, so deterministic behavior and state shape require focused tests.

children.title: Versioned API, SSE, and static server
children.objective: Add the /api/v1 HTTP surface for state, order creation, reservation, status transitions, deterministic simulation actions, a monotonic SSE stream, and static asset serving through the start script.
expectedOutcomes: The start script runs a dependency-free Node server that serves static UI assets and the versioned /api/v1 endpoints.
/api/v1 state, order creation, reservation, status transition, and simulation action endpoints validate inputs and return understandable errors for invalid requests.
/api/v1/events emits monotonic Server-Sent Events suitable for browser consumption.
API/SSE tests verify public behavior, event monotonicity, invalid transition responses, simulation actions, and that existing build/typecheck/test scripts remain coherent.

complexitySignals.rationale: The leaf owns the public transport contract, the SSE event stream, static serving integration, and package script changes needed to run and test them.

children.title: Accessible warehouse tower UI
children.objective: Add the static browser UI with SVG heatmap, textual bin detail including empty bins, keyboard-operable simulation controls, explicit connection and lifecycle states, reduced-motion support, and non-color-only status communication.
expectedOutcomes: The first served page is the usable warehouse tower UI, not a placeholder or marketing page.
The UI renders an SVG warehouse tower heatmap and exact textual bin detail for occupied and empty bins.
Simulation controls are keyboard operable and communicate state through text, labels, and structure rather than color alone.
Loading, empty, error, connected, and reduced-motion states are explicit and testable.
Tower accessibility tests verify semantic controls, state text, reduced-motion support, empty-bin detail, and API/SSE integration points.

complexitySignals.rationale: The UI is static but acceptance-critical, with accessibility, keyboard, lifecycle-state, and reduced-motion obligations.

children.title: WC1 deterministic probe
children.objective: Add src/probe/wc1.ts and study:wc1-probe so one deterministic JSON object reports the WC1 thesis scenario summary and simulation controls without changing the existing W1 probe behavior.
expectedOutcomes: src/probe/wc1.ts emits exactly one deterministic JSON object for scenario thesis-seed-2026.
The emitted object includes schemaVersion 1, increment WC1, scenario thesis-seed-2026, bins, occupiedBins, emptyBins and simulationControls.
package.json exposes study:wc1-probe without removing or changing the existing study:probe behavior.
Probe tests verify determinism, required fields, and preservation of the existing W1 probe contract.

complexitySignals.rationale: The probe adds a new command-facing contract while depending on existing probe/scenario conventions and the shared simulation state.
